ROW FOUR: blank ivory counting tile with no marking; ornate burgundy and gold playing-card back with a sun rosette; blank dark wooden rune stave, no glyphs; blank parchment playing-card face with a subtle thin gold border. All objects fully visible. Make silhouettes distinguishable when shrunk to 50 pixels.
